title: Bounded ordinary constant-field realization of field-stage complexes
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ as in [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], and a scheme $Y$. Use a small representative of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], constant ring sheaves $R_Y$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and their ordinary derived categories. For each finite coefficient field $E\subset\Qlb$, let $R_E=\mathcal O_E$, with uniformizer $\varpi_E$, as in [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and put $B_E=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. The compatible maps from the constant sheaf $(R_E)_Y$ to its constant quotient sheaves give a ring-sheaf map $u_E:(R_E)_Y\to B_E$. Let $U_E:D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_E))\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},R_E)$ be termwise restriction of scalars along $u_E$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars].

There are functors
$$J_E:D^b_c(Y,E)\longrightarrow D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},E)$$
from the raw scalar localizations [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], specified on the integral objects $C\in D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] by
$$J_E(C)=U_E(C)\otimes^L_{(R_E)_Y}E_Y,$$
using ordinary derived tensor [def-weil-derived-tensor], and on a scalar-localized morphism $f\otimes a$, $a\in E$, by $J_E(f\otimes a)=a\,J_E(f)$. These formulas give well-defined $E$-linear functors, and every $J_E(C)$ is cohomologically bounded [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves].

For each inclusion $E\subset L$ of finite coefficient fields there is a natural isomorphism
$$J_L(C\otimes_E L)\cong J_E(C)\otimes^L_{E_Y}L_Y,$$
where $C\otimes_E L$ is the transition functor of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. The isomorphisms are compatible with identity inclusions and with composition for $E\subset L\subset M$. Consequently the formulas
$$J_{\Qlb}(E,C)=J_E(C)\otimes^L_{E_Y}(\Qlb)_Y$$
and, for a morphism represented over a common finite field $L$, its image under $J_L$ followed by scalar extension to $(\Qlb)_Y$, give a well-defined $\Qlb$-linear functor
$$J_{\Qlb}:D^b_c(Y,\Qlb)\longrightarrow D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\Qlb)$$
from the common-stage category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Its values are cohomologically bounded. All coefficient sheaves in the targets of $J_E$ and $J_{\Qlb}$ are the discrete constant sheaves; no assertion that these target objects have constructible cohomology as constant-coefficient sheaves is made.
